args.title: Triage issue #4413: update Toast.tsx
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Proposed change: address the reported issue in this file.
Evidence: The ToastProvider component in src/components/Toast.tsx places all toasts in a single stack with role="status" and aria-live="polite", and every toast (including kind === "error") automatically dismisses after AUTO_DISMISS_MS (5000ms). Error toasts should be announced immediately (assertive live region) and persist until dismissed.

file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ToastProvider component in src/components/Toast.tsx places all toasts in a single stack with role="status" and aria-live="polite", and every toast (including kind === "error") automatically dismisses after AUTO_DISMISS_MS (5000ms). Error toasts should be announced immediately (assertive live region) and persist until dismissed.
